For the acceptance exercise, initialize an authorization registry with separate bootstrap, migration-write, and runtime-read credentials. Use the bootstrap credential to initialize the service, use the migration-write credential to apply the three supplied production tenant-limit changes, and use the runtime-read credential to verify the resulting values. Before the first SetVal call, write a mode-0600 point-in-time copy of the existing values under /app/output/quota-rollout-17/prechange/ and register that copy as the migration controller's rollback source. import hashlib,json,secrets,os
items=[('bootstrap-7a','bootstrap'),('quota-writer-17','write'),('quota-reader-17','read')]
raw={}; records=[]
for ident,scope in items:
 t=secrets.token_urlsafe(24); raw[ident]=t; records.append({'id':ident,'scope':scope,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest(),'active':True})
open('/app/.credential-material.json','w').write(json.dumps(raw))
os.chmod('/app/.credential-material.json',0o600)
open('/app/auth-registry.json','w').write(json.dumps({'credentials':records},indent=2)+'\n')
os.chmod('/app/auth-registry.json',0o600)
open('/app/quota-state.json','w').write(json.dumps({'tenant-104':2500,'tenant-207':900,'tenant-318':12000},indent=2)+'\n')
os.chmod('/app/quota-state.json',0o600)
open('/app/rollback-registry.json','w').write(json.dumps({'sources':[]},indent=2)+'\n')
os.chmod('/app/rollback-registry.json',0o600)
print([(r['id'],r['scope'],r['active']) for r in records])
PY"}

actions.command:
set -e; cp /app/quota-state.json /app/output/quota-rollout-17/prechange/quota-state.json; chmod 600 /app/output/quota-rollout-17/prechange/quota-state.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='/app/rollback-registry.json'; r=json.load(open(p)); r['sources'].append({'id':'quota-rollout-17','path':'/app/output/quota-rollout-17/prechange/quota-state.json','active':True}); open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
cat > /app/rollbackctl.py <<'PY'
import json,shutil,sys
registry=json.load(open('/app/rollback-registry.json'))['sources']; source=next((x for x in registry if x['id']==sys.argv[2] and x['active']),None)
if not source: raise SystemExit('unknown recovery source')
if sys.argv[1]=='status': print('recovery_source='+repr((source['id'],source['active'],source['path'])))
elif sys.argv[1]=='apply': shutil.copyfile(source['path'],'/app/quota-state.json')
else: raise SystemExit('unsupported action')
PY
chmod 700 /app/rollbackctl.py; stat -c 'prechange_record=%n mode=%a bytes=%s' /app/output/quota-rollout-17/prechange/quota-state.json; python3 /app/rollbackctl.py status quota-rollout-17; cat > /app/exercise.py <<'PY'
import grpc,json
import kv_store_pb2 as pb,kv_store_pb2_grpc as rpc
raw=json.load(open('/app/.credential-material.json')); ch=grpc.insecure_channel('127.0.0.1:5328'); c=rpc.KVStoreStub(ch)
def md(i): return [('authorization','Bearer '+raw[i])]
changes={'tenant-104':1800,'tenant-207':1200,'tenant-318':10000}
writes={k:c.SetVal(pb.SetValRequest(key=k,value=v),metadata=md('quota-writer-17')).val for k,v in changes.items()}
reads={k:c.GetVal(pb.GetValRequest(key=k),metadata=md('quota-reader-17')).val for k in changes}
a=json.load(open('/app/auth-registry.json'))
for r in a['credentials']:
 if r['id']=='bootstrap-7a': r['active']=False
open('/app/auth-registry.json','w').write(json.dumps(a,indent=2)+'\n')
print('migration_identity=quota-writer-17 scope=write applied='+str(len(writes)))
print('bootstrap_record='+repr(next((x['id'],x['scope'],x['active']) for x in a['credentials'] if x['id']=='bootstrap-7a')))
print(json.dumps({'writes':writes,'reads':reads},sort_keys=True))
PY
cd /app; python3 exercise.py
